items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Miss Crim, that owned the hotel there in Augusta, Georgia .. used to take all the show people; everybody used to stay there at her place, but she was the one that let us stay in these rooms.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's how we used to do that. But one time we were leaving Columbia, South Carolina, in this bus, and we got outside of Akens, and the motor fell out on the highway, so they had to pull us into Augusta, Georgia, and it cost $250 to get this bus fixed.

So what happened, we didn't want to send home and let our folks know that we were out there bad up, my first time getting stranded, and that's why up to this day I don't like cinnamon buns, because every time we got stranded, that's what I had to eat -- stale ones, at that!
